a:r.a:t: The migration to Rift is designed to be zero-friction. Here's the process:
Step one: Replace the Docker image. That's it - change one line in your docker-compose or Kubernetes deployment.
Step two: Point to your existing configuration files. Rift uses the same command-line flags as Mountebank: configfile for a single file, datadir for a directory of imposter files.
Step three: Run your tests. They should work exactly as before, just faster.
This isn't theoretical - I've tested it with our Solo configurations. 35 imposter files with 674 stubs total loaded and ran correctly on Rift with no modifications.
The reason this works is that Rift implements 100% of Mountebank's REST API. Same endpoints, same request/response formats, same configuration schema. It's designed to be a drop-in replacement.
